race.comment: BRUTAL BELLE (2) gets the nod on the strength of her Canberra win two starts back, when she came from well back to beat Steel Knight, and her latest Kembla Grange run is easier to excuse after she began awkwardly and was bumped. Expecting her to bounce back in a big way. COSMIC EAGLE (6) is the obvious danger after stringing together wins at Newcastle and Nowra, the latest in CL1 company as favourite. The form out of her last start has already been franked and she can bring up the hat-trick. KIRMISH (8) returns from metro FM BM72 company and her previous CL2 second at this venue reads well. POINT SCORE (9) didn't feature at Kembla last start but the run prior on the Illawarra Grange track stands up. Back to country level now and a better effort is anticipated.
